thread:
cara: Quick heads-up — I'm going to run a focused tidy on the seedbank near-duplicate heuristics before we flip the q6b canary. Found a nasty cluster of near-duplicates that survived fuzzyhash thresholds.
ben: thanks — is this causing noisy evals or labeler churn?
alice: saw the spike in goldset disagreement yesterday, might be related. can you share repro?
cara: repro query below. it's a 2-stage hit: fuzzyhash score ~0.86 + tokenizer span overlap > 0.7.
```
-- sample query
SELECT id, fuzzy_score, span_overlap FROM seedbank
WHERE fuzzy_score > 0.85 AND span_overlap > 0.7
ORDER BY fuzzy_score DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
ben: hmm. our dedupe pipeline currently thresholds fuzzy_score at 0.9. so these sit in the gray zone.
dan: those 0.86s are classic paraphrase families — semantics same but formatting different. do we want stricter fuzzy threshold or add a secondary embedding check?
evie: embedding check will be more compute-y but better signal. what about a cheap approximate: token-shingle Jaccard + prefix fingerprint?
cara: proposal: 1) run batch to label these gray-zone pairs with label-bot, 2) add shingle_jaccard > 0.65 as tie-breaker, 3) mark a micro-golden of 200 pairs for manual review, 4) run canary after one sweep.
alice: label-bot can kick off. I can triage the micro-golden with two reviewers. timeline?
cara: aiming for sweep today, micro-golden ready EOD, canary next Tue when q6b longctx tests are green.
ben: small ask — update the sampler so these pairs are prioritized for labeling (high-entropy bucket). otherwise they'll be drowned.
dan: I'll patch sampler config. snippet: `priority_rules: - condition: fuzzy_score between 0.85 and 0.9 -> weight: 10`
evie: also add a small guard to avoid dropping true near-duplicates from training: if both examples have different doc_ids but same source_domain, mark REVIEW instead of DROP.
cara: good call. alice, can you own the micro-golden review? ben/dan, can you land sampler+tie-breaker by EOD? i'll run the sweep and fire label-bot.
alice: can do, pairing with marta for third-party review.
ben: patch incoming — will open PR and tag @cara @alice.
dan: merged sampler change to staging. monitoring alert to watch labeler backlog: `label-queue-depth > 500` if it spikes.
label-bot: automated: created labeling job seedbank-grayzone-1755012345 with 1200 pairs. reviewers: alice, marta, evie.
evie: FYI added shingle_jaccard implementation to infra-lib under dedupe.utils: `jaccard_shingles(text, k=5)`. small perf hit (~5%) on batch.
cara: perf ok for one-time sweep. after review we can flip default tie-break to include shingle check.
alice: micro-golden task created: MG-1755, reviewers assigned. will report disagreements >3 back to this thread.
ben: one more thought — while we're at it, collect the tokenizer-span-length distribution for these pairs; might help with quantization edgecases later.
cara: noted. dan, can you add a simple export to the sweep that includes token_length_diff and kvcache-friendly flag?
dan: yes. will include fields: token_len_a, token_len_b, kvcache_footprint_est.
alice: starting review now, will ping on major splits.
cara: thanks all. if micro-golden looks clean, i'll schedule the q6b canary next Tue and include de-dupe changes in the canary config. :thumbsup:
label-bot: update: 320 pairs completed, 24 flagged AMBIGUOUS, 6 conflicts assigned for adjudication.
evie: flagged ones look like small template differences — might need a lighter-touch merge rule.
cara: keep flags. we'll adjudicate after full sweep. goal: reduce eval jitter and labeler re-rates on canary.
ben: noted. I'll watch the label backlog alert and throttle if needed.
alice: final note — please add a small blurb to the canary runbook about the de-dupe rule change so SRE and eng-runtime know to expect slight eval metric shifts.
cara: will add to runbook now. thanks everyone.
